authority: 2026-09-10 owner requested inspecting the newly open second model to improve the broader beam plan; then informed us they saved it in another folder and ran analysis.
objective: Acquire a bounded read-only model inventory and conditional representative frame sample through the existing ETABS host controls, then refine the maintained plan using actual observations.
bounded_units: I1: separate inspection getter profile and worker with count-first admission
I2: exact installed-instance discovery and conditional definition sample
I3: sanitized receipt, plan refinement and one delivery candidate

acceptance_rows.outcome: Exact PID/start/executable and newly saved model identity are bound before reads; no setters, analysis, design execution, saving, selections or ETABS termination.
An independent read-only profile reuses the existing host, process lease, STA, deadline/quiescence, journal and cleanup owners; legacy profiles retain their hashes and semantics.

Inventory records native units, counts, stories, case statuses, result and table selections, table availability and concrete-design availability. Each unavailable family has a precise failure or admission reason.
A separate optional sample uses at most 20 exact frames after a bounded source catalog; no All-group force call, table rows, shell/time-history rows or general full-model capture.
Pre/post state and exact file/process identity agree, all getter calls are journaled, timeout does not release a live provider lease, and artifacts publish only after cleanup.

Focused fake-host tests cover counts versus CSI return codes, over-budget admission, provider failure, selection/model drift and legacy broker compatibility; installed evidence records timings and bytes without PF9 qualification.

Raw model identifiers and data remain external. Safe summaries map observations to BC rows and next C0a-C0c work; second model is development evidence, not independent-source proof, a holdout, or broad design support.

bounds.force_results: not requested by the inspection profile

non_goals: Source-model mutation, installed Excel changes, packaging installation or release
Full result extraction, database export, schema-wide qualification, or PF9 certification
Other worktrees, source/licensing permission changes or cleanup
likely_pitfalls: Reusing the prior saved filename after the owner moved the model
Treating positive Count values as CSI errors
Assuming output and table display selections agree
Treating a worker timeout as stopped ETABS
Calling an unbounded All group before checking its rows
Treating a metadata or geometry sample as complete structural support

focused: Wp10InspectionTests plus existing getter and broker tests
verification.installed: Exact read-only source identity, paired call journal, protected-state equality, operation time, worker memory and artifact hashes retained outside Git.
